top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §744.2753(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a working thermometer.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver didn't have their file available during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was not a record of monthly fire drills conducted for licensing to review.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §744.303(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not report a change in director.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §744.305(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A director was not listed as a controlling person for the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 children need emergency contact information for child admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent (26 TAC §744.2669)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with food allergies did not have a food allergy plan.
